title: A Mountain of Chairs  (堆积如山的椅子)

segments.t: Hannah 和 Tessa 怀里抱着包好的杯子和菜篮，推开庭院的铁门，看到 Arthur 被一摞摞高高的木椅子团团围住，顿时惊呆了。我们先来听一遍完整的场景对话。
Arthur?! Where did all these wooden chairs come from?!
There is a wall of chairs from the lemon pot all the way to the stairs!
Good news first: every single chair was fifty percent off!
And what is the bad news, Arthur?
I asked for six, agreed to twenty-four, and accidentally said 'today'!
How will our upstairs guests walk to the street without climbing over wood?!
Wait, look how flat each chair folds when you press the side latch!
Oh! Four folded chairs take no more space than one suitcase!
Really? Show me that latch, Hannah!
Lift the seat slightly, fold it flat, and lean twelve neatly under the dry arch.
And put twelve straight into Room Nine once Graham finishes the lamp!
Hannah, promoting you to permanent receptionist saved my life twice in two days!
现在我们来逐句看看细节。
Arthur?! Where did all these wooden chairs come from?!
“Arthur！？这些木椅子都是从哪儿冒出来的！？” 要询问突然出现的事物的来历，疑问句以 Where 开头、以 from 结尾：
come from?!
把介词放在句末。
There is a wall of chairs from the lemon pot all the way to the stairs!
“从柠檬树花盆一直到楼梯，堵成了一堵椅子墙！”为了强调一排物品占满整段距离、毫无空隙，可以用以下表达来加强 to：
all the way to
从而标出整段距离。
Good news first: every single chair was fifty percent off!
“先说好消息：每一把椅子都打了五折！”在这个表达中，在 every 后面加上 single：
every single chair
用来强调没有任何例外。
And what is the bad news, Arthur?
“那坏消息是什么呢，Arthur？”请记住，news 是不可数名词，后面总是接单数动词，比如这句：
what is the bad news,
尽管它以 -s 结尾。
I asked for six, agreed to twenty-four, and accidentally said 'today'!
“我本来只要六把，结果答应了二十四把，还不小心说成今天送！”三个过去式动词概括了这场灾难：ask for 表示“请求、要某物”，而
agreed to twenty-four,
在表示同意某个条件或数字时，后面要搭配介词 to。
How will our upstairs guests walk to the street without climbing over wood?!
“我们楼上的客人怎么才能不翻过这堆木头走到街上去啊！？”在介词 without 后面，动词要加 -ing 词尾：
without climbing over
就像在 before 或 after 后面一样。
Wait, look how flat each chair folds when you press the side latch!
“等等，你们看按下侧边卡扣时，每把椅子能折得多平整！”为了赞叹椅子折叠后的样子，可以把 how 和形容词组合起来使用，例如：
how flat each chair folds
在这里，fold 本身就表示“折叠起来”。
Oh! Four folded chairs take no more space than one suitcase!
“哇！四把折叠起来的椅子占的空间还没一个行李箱大！”在谈论空间或体积时，动词 take 相当于“占用”，就像这句：
take no more space than
这是一个非常简洁又实用的比较表达。
Really? Show me that latch, Hannah!
“真的吗？快让我看看那个卡扣，Hannah！”固定折叠机构的金属部件或侧边保险扣叫作
that latch,
就像门或窗户上的插销一样。
Lift the seat slightly, fold it flat, and lean twelve neatly under the dry arch.
“把座面微微抬起，折平，然后把十二把整整齐齐地靠放在干爽的拱门下面。”放在动词后面的形容词 flat 在这里表示动作产生的结果状态，例如：
fold it flat,
而 lean 的意思是把东西斜靠在墙上。
And put twelve straight into Room Nine once Graham finishes the lamp!
“等 Graham 把灯修好，我们立刻把十二把直接搬进九号房！”作为时间连词，
once Graham finishes
即使指代将来的时间，后面也要用一般现在时。
Hannah, promoting you to permanent receptionist saved my life twice in two days!
“Hannah，把你升为正式前台真是在两天内救了我两次命！”动名词短语放在句首作主语，例如：
promoting you to
新职位跟在介词 to 后面。我们再来听一遍完整对话。
Arthur?! Where did all these wooden chairs come from?!
There is a wall of chairs from the lemon pot all the way to the stairs!
Good news first: every single chair was fifty percent off!
And what is the bad news, Arthur?
I asked for six, agreed to twenty-four, and accidentally said 'today'!
How will our upstairs guests walk to the street without climbing over wood?!
Wait, look how flat each chair folds when you press the side latch!
Oh! Four folded chairs take no more space than one suitcase!
Really? Show me that latch, Hannah!
Lift the seat slightly, fold it flat, and lean twelve neatly under the dry arch.
And put twelve straight into Room Nine once Graham finishes the lamp!
Hannah, promoting you to permanent receptionist saved my life twice in two days!
把椅子折叠得平平整整后，庭院的过道几分钟内就畅通了，Arthur 的疏忽也变成了干爽拱门下整齐的一排。我们去看看九号房的灯是不是已经准备好了。
Take care!
